name: Etoricoxib
sections: White to off-white powder, slightly soluble in water.

The MEDAL programme (34,701 patients) showed thrombotic cardiovascular event rates comparable to diclofenac with fewer upper GI events. First approval/introduction: Patented 1996; approved 2002 (Merck & Co.) – approved in >80 countries, not in the USA.

Highly selective inhibitor of cyclo-oxygenase-2, reducing prostaglandin synthesis at sites of inflammation while largely sparing COX-1-mediated gastric protection and platelet function. Receptor / target profile: Highly selective COX-2 inhibitor (~106-fold COX-2 over COX-1 in human whole-blood assays).
Summary: Bioavailability ~100%; Tmax ~1 h. ~92% protein bound. Metabolised by CYP3A4. Half-life ~22 h (once-daily dosing).
